title: SPEADI: Accelerated Analysis of IDP-Ion Interactions from MD-Trajectories.
authors: de Bruyn, Emile; Dorn, Anton Emil; Zimmermann, Olav; Rossetti, Giulia
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了基于MD轨迹的时间分辨径向分布函数工具SPEADI，用于分析IDP与离子的动态相互作用，虽聚焦IDP-离子而非PPI，但动态环境表征方法对IDP互作机制建模有可迁移启发。
abstract: The disordered nature of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins (IDPs) makes their structural ensembles particularly susceptible to changes in chemical environmental conditions, often leading to an alteration of their normal functions. A Radial Distribution Function (RDF) is considered a standard method for characterizing the chemical environment surrounding particles during atomistic simulations, commonly averaged over an entire or part of a trajectory. Given their high structural variability, such averaged information might not be reliable for IDPs. We introduce the Time-Resolved Radial Distribution Function (TRRDF), implemented in our open-source Python package SPEADI, which is able to characterize dynamic environments around IDPs. We use SPEADI to characterize the dynamic distribution of ions around the IDPs Alpha-Synuclein (AS) and Humanin (HN) from Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, and some of their selected mutants, showing that local ion-residue interactions play an important role in the structures and behaviors of IDPs.
abstract_zh: intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 的无序本质使其结构系综对化学环境条件的变化尤为敏感，这常导致其正常功能的改变。径向分布函数 (Radial Distribution Function, RDF) 被视为在原子模拟中表征粒子周围化学环境的标准方法，通常对整个或部分轨迹进行平均。鉴于 IDPs 的高度结构变异性，这种平均信息可能对其并不可靠。我们引入了时间分辨径向分布函数 (Time-Resolved Radial Distribution Function, TRRDF)，并在我们的开源 Python 包 SPEADI 中实现，该函数能够表征 IDPs 周围的动态环境。我们使用 SPEADI 从分子动力学 (Molecular Dynamics, MD) 模拟中表征 IDPs Alpha-Synuclein (AS) 和 Humanin (HN) 及其部分选定突变体周围的离子动态分布，表明局部离子-残基相互作用在 IDPs 的结构和行为中扮演重要角色。
